title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
variant: exlr8 K3 bit300, hybrid GPU + host RAM, MTP=4
summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next K3 (bit300, 3.00 bpw) on one Blackwell GPU with gr8: hot routed experts in VRAM, cold experts in pinned host RAM run on AVX-512 CPU threads and the GPU, FP8 dense weights and an INT4 MTP=4 drafter, under a 22.9 GiB VRAM ceiling.

configs.label: 1 GPU

quality.name: Greedy token parity, GPU UVA vs AVX-512 CPU MoE (MTP=0)

configs.notes: 1x RTX 5090 32 GB, Ryzen 7 9800X3D, 128 GB DDR5. HTTP streaming /v1/chat/completions, temperature 0, 3-run medians, under a 22.9 GiB VRAM ceiling (about 7.2 GiB of other services resident on the card); 6,853 hot experts in VRAM. MTP=4, cap 40960. Measured on gr8 main with PR #610 (5cedece3); re-measurement on published gr8 v1.3.1 linux/amd64 image pending RTX 5090 hardware.
